purpose: Independent, candidate-only comparison of the exact and anchor-deleted pure motif domains emitted by P1 production-v2 and the P2 legacy ready-LMDB census. The report quantifies overlap and semantic drift; it cannot select a union, cutoff, OOV policy or tokenizer.
required_inputs: complete P1 production-v2 full_release_manifest.json and its global motif_census.jsonl
candidate P2 census derivation_receipt.json and all hash-bound census artifacts
P2 source lock and census extraction contract

projection.algorithm: Validate canonical <nonnegative_decimal*> anchors, delete them from each exact fragment without any other normalization, reject residual angle brackets or an empty core, and wrap the exact remaining core in one square-bracket pair.

overlap: P1/P2 exact unique counts, shared unique count and phase-specific occurrence coverage
P1/P2 pure unique counts, shared unique count and phase-specific occurrence coverage
collapse: number of pure tokens backed by multiple exact lexemes
maximum exact lexemes per pure token
stereochemistry: unique exact lexemes and weighted occurrences containing @
unique exact lexemes and weighted occurrences containing /
unique exact lexemes and weighted occurrences containing backslash
anchors: unique exact lexemes and weighted occurrences containing anchors
P2 record counts passing/failing the measured P1 pair rule

output.direct_projection_domain_compatible: true only when every fail-closed semantic rule is proven compatible

fail_closed: Every input contract, manifest, receipt and census artifact is SHA-256 verified before comparison.
The P2 pure census must equal an independent recomputation from the P2 exact census.
Digest-to-distinct-fragment and pure-digest-to-distinct-token collisions abort the audit.
An absent/unknown producer or missing semantic evidence cannot be converted into compatibility by high lexical overlap.
The report is created once and contains a self-hash over all preceding fields.
